stageNotes: Stage 1: Apex returns 200 cleanly; www 301-redirects to apex. Canonical = https://wolverinesupplies.com.

Stage 2: Heavy 8-batch probe — all 200, cf-ray present, no challenges. Honeypot /wp-admin etc. 403 because BC isn't WordPress (origin default). No CAPTCHA markers, no age-gate. hasWaf=false (operational; cf-ray passive doesn't gate the crawler).

Stage 3: Meta tag <meta name='platform' content='bigcommerce.stencil' /> + cdn11.bigcommerce.com + x-bc-store-id: 1003335859 + BC-Ray header. Plain HTTP returns 100 products on /firearms/ -> needsPlaywright=false.

Stage 4: 15 top-level categories from homepage nav. Walked all 15 (with sleep 0.8s between requests). Per-cat union = 5697 unique IDs; shop-all aggregator walks 5579 (less than per-cat -> dropped). /training/ returns 200 with 0 products -> kept (empty != dead per skill rule). Sitemap shows 8173 product URLs; gap is OOS/hidden BC products absent from category pages.
Stage 4g: Extraction sample on 3 products -> all yielded title + URL + price/stock (one in_stock with $750, two unknown stockStatus due to listing-only context).

Stage 5: Pagination = ?page=N query. Page1 vs page2 zero-overlap confirmed (page1 IDs 6788,6791,6793 vs page2 5858,5859,5860). perPage probed: ?limit=2500 returned full /parts/ category (1206 products) in 5s. Conservative perPage=250 baked into catalogUrls.

Stage 6: 3-outcome test on /firearms/. default DOM order = IDs 9026,9016,9013 (descending); ?sort=newest = same; ?sort=alphaasc = 544,545,941 (alphabetic). Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam='?sort=newest' (explicit) for clarity; sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: Watermark = navigate-from-watermark. Default page 1 is newest-first. Walks backward to find watermark, forward to index new.

Stage 8: Sitemap method — /xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1 returns 8173 <loc> entries (all product URLs, no category/brand mixing). Verified second page (?page=2) returns 404 — single-page sitemap. Walked-union (5697) under-counts vs sitemap due to BC Stencil OOS hidden on category pages — sitemap is canonical inventory.
